metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2019 · The Hateful Eight: Extended Version
metas.description: The re-edited, extended, serialized cut of Quentin Tarantino's 2015 Western. Some years after the Civil War, bounty hunter John Ruth (Kurt Russell) escorts fugitive Daisy Domergue (Jennifer Jason Leigh) to face justice in the town of Red Rock. As a blizzard closes in, they seek refuge at Minnie's Haberdashery, a stagecoach stopover on a mountain pass, but on arrival they are greeted not by the proprietor but by unfamiliar faces. And as the storm overtakes the mountainside stopover, the travelers realize they may not make it to Red Rock after all…

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2017 · Damnation
metas.description: An epic saga about the secret history of the 1930s American heartland, centering on the mythic conflict and bloody struggle between big money and the downtrodden.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2017 · The Son
metas.description: A multi-generational epic telling of the story of America's birth as a superpower through the bloody rise and fall of one Texas oil empire.
